title: Launch ramp playbook: staggered rollouts, cut criteria and release notes coordination for API/Console/Runtime
creator: Anya Patel
description: Create an operational playbook to run a controlled, staggered launch across the Redwood API, Console and Runtime components. The goal is to define milestone checkpoints, explicit scope-lock rules, cut criteria, communication templates for internal and external stakeholders, and an automated checklist for release notes assembly. This ticket coordinates cross-team owners, defines canary & ramp triggers, identifies rollback decision signals, and documents required dashboards and PR links. Emphasis on minimizing customer-facing regressions while enabling a predictable ramp to full fleet rollout.
